name: Midnight Stop
source:
It's late and you've been caught in the rain after working your last shift... While waiting at the bus stop, you sense an unfamiliar presence approaching. You don't know who he is, but... something about them intrigues and terrifies you.

Will you ignore him, or will you want to know who he is and what he wants?

[Translated from [url=https://skullmyst.itch.io/midnightstp]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
天色已晚，你下完最后一班工作后，被雨淋湿了……在公交车站等车时，你感觉到有一个陌生的东西正在靠近。你不知道他是谁，但是……他们身上的某些东西让你好奇又害怕。

你会忽略他，还是想知道他是谁以及他想要什么？

[译自[url=https://skullmyst.itch.io/midnightstp]Itch.io[/url]]
